title: Movement deserves
caption: A testing walkthrough of ParkinSense PK, a functional monitoring prototype.

title: Six assessment sections
caption: The app covers walking, hands, sit-to-stand, reach and grasp, voice, and daily activities.

title: Walking, in three dimensions
caption: These 3D landmarks come from a real walking recording. They are model estimates, not calibrated clinical measurements.

title: Small movements. Visible patterns.
caption: The hand replay shows measured motion over time. This source does not identify the participant’s diagnosis.

title: Voice has a place here, too
caption: The voice module measures signal activity, pauses and pitch. It does not diagnose Parkinson’s or automatically transcribe speech.

title: Results that can be reviewed
caption: Reports bring measurements and limitations together, with clinician review still required.

title: Show the checks. And the gaps.
caption: The archived suite passed 463 tests. Wrong-task checks also exposed an important limitation that still needs work.

title: The next step is validation
caption: The next phase is independent measurement validation, patient usability testing and supervised clinic evaluation.

title: Built with evidence in view
caption: Demo visuals are derived from cited research recordings. No clinical accuracy or treatment claim is made.
